scope.purpose: Validate a proposed deterministic bridge-descriptor and synthetic subprocess-protocol fixture model without invoking an evaluation runner or registering a production callback.

adapters_readme.use: Protocol-v1 request/result shape, explicit adapter environment, no downloads, single-attempt worker, deny-by-default/no-network sandbox and attempt-dir write boundary.

board_snapshot.use: Immutable task-local excerpt of the claimed/in_progress board record, component record and history; observed live board digest f4ccc85e955be6b358e891b887fda1901de7d9d2f73c3ac92dc8f88d2d69c24b.

verification_profile.use: Tool profile: provenance, clean checkout, typical use, caller-owned inputs, malformed inputs and missing optional selections.

inventory.use: Component disposition sdk-tool and tool verification profile.

public_provider_header.use: Public ABI constants: 16 kHz, mono, 160 samples, 16 assets, source-linked provider contract; unchanged.

public_session_header.use: Public session facade and build identity; unchanged.

sdk_contracts.use: External asset identity and no-provider-file/network-access boundary; unchanged.

authoring_runtime.provenance: Python standard library only; no third-party package, download, network access, corpus, licensed runtime or target-device workload.

external_worker_reference.provenance: adapters/README.md at the pinned digest above
external_worker_reference.reason_not_invoked: Tool/evidence boundary only: no real evaluation runner, licensed runtime, real corpora or target-device workload is present in this package.

status_codes.ok: Descriptor, request and result are syntactically and semantically valid; still never qualified in this package.
status_codes.ok_omitted: Valid request with an explicitly omitted optional selection; no default is inferred.
status_codes.blocked: Sandbox or nested-profile precondition failed; no result qualifies.
status_codes.rejected: Malformed, missing-required, nonfinite, unverified-asset or boundary-violating input.
status_codes.incomplete: Result absent or unreadable; no result qualifies.

bridge_descriptor_fields.descriptor_id: Immutable identifier of this evidence descriptor.
bridge_descriptor_fields.protocol: Protocol identifier; only audioml-adapter/1 is accepted.
bridge_descriptor_fields.workspace_root: Symbolic /workspace root used to resolve the entrypoint; no path outside the explicit grants is readable.
bridge_descriptor_fields.entrypoint: Symbolic, evidence-only entrypoint; never resolved or executed by this harness.
bridge_descriptor_fields.writable_roots: Explicit allowlist; must contain only the attempt directory.
bridge_descriptor_fields.read_grants: Explicit caller-owned input/asset/code/environment roots; duplicates and path escapes are rejected.
bridge_descriptor_fields.source_paths: Explicit workspace-relative source roots; no implicit resolution.
bridge_descriptor_fields.production_callback: Must be none; evaluation execution and production callbacks remain distinct.

sandbox_profile.nested_parent_sandbox: fail_closed with an explicit blocked reason
sandbox_profile.result_validation: Manifest, asset IDs and hashes validated before any success status

execution_modes.reason: This package validates descriptors and synthetic manifests only; no production callback or SDK session is created.

measured_workload_support.reason: No latency, throughput, speech-quality, device or release measurement is in scope; DEFER before any production exposure.
